note: Roles, not models: the first candidate OpenRouter still lists and can call tools is shown. Prices always come from OpenRouter at the moment you choose, never from this file.

roles.title: Everyday
roles.why: Quick, dependable with Luma's tools, and a small fraction of a cent for most questions.

roles.title: Building apps and widgets
roles.why: Strong at writing and fixing code over many steps. Costs more per question, still modest.

roles.title: Most capable
roles.why: The largest models for the hardest work. Each question can cost several cents, and long tasks far more.
